name: cogentspec
description: Connect isolated AI project contexts to CogentSpec Web through one account-bound Desktop Bridge, restore portable Git-backed knowledge, and execute approved local actions.

interface.shortDescription: CogentSpec Web, one Bridge, isolated AI contexts.
interface.longDescription: CogentSpec keeps official ChatGPT, Codex, and Claude desktop applications independent and connects their isolated project contexts to CogentSpec Web through one account-bound Desktop Bridge. Invoking CogentSpec resolves the current stable project context, starts or reuses its quiet Bridge worker, returns the independent web-browser link, and opens the in-task workspace through the desktop app’s native browser-tab action. Approved project creation, permanent deletion, verified local preview, Git, and deployment-preparation requests are queued by the hosted workspace and executed through narrow server-authoritative helpers. Portable Git-backed project knowledge supports continuity across AI projects and computers while protected contracts, execution grants, licence validation, and subscriber data remain on the CogentSpec service.
defaultPrompt: Connect this AI project to CogentSpec Web.
Load the active project's portable knowledge.
Return this project's isolated CogentSpec Web link.
